solutionTitle: What we build inside your GoHighLevel
solutionItems: A single workflow triggered by every lead source: forms, paid ads, and inbound calls.
Instant multi-channel outreach that opens with SMS and escalates to an AI voice call.
Real qualification that asks intent, timing, and fit, then tags the contact accordingly.
Live calendar booking so a qualified lead lands on your calendar without a human touching it.

layers.title: The trigger layer
layers.body: Every lead source in GoHighLevel points at one workflow. A form submit, an ad lead, or a missed inbound call all fire the same instant response, so nothing slips through a gap between tools.

layers.title: The conversation layer
layers.body: SMS goes out in seconds, and if there is no reply the AI voice agent calls. It qualifies in natural conversation, handles common questions, and knows when to book versus when to nurture. We build these agents on Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT Codex, so the logic is tuned per business, not a generic script.

layers.title: The booking and handoff layer
layers.body: A qualified lead is offered live open slots and books directly onto your calendar. The owner gets a clean summary and a warm handoff, so the human time goes to closing, not chasing.

proofTitle: Why this wins on the numbers
proofBullets: Contact a lead within one minute instead of waiting two, and conversion climbs sharply, so seconds are worth real money.
Respond inside five minutes and the lead is far more likely to qualify and to actually pick up, which is exactly the window the workflow protects.
The business that replies first takes most of the deals, and the workflow makes you that first responder on every lead.

faq.question: How fast does the workflow actually respond to a new lead?
faq.answer: Within seconds. The moment a form, ad, or inbound call hits GoHighLevel, the workflow fires SMS and can escalate to an AI voice call. This matters because calling within one minute instead of two has been shown to lift conversion by 391% (Velocify).

faq.question: Does this replace my sales team?
faq.answer: No, it gives them leverage. The workflow handles the instant response, qualification, and booking that humans cannot do at 2am or while on another call. Your team spends its time closing qualified, booked calls instead of chasing cold leads.

faq.question: What does the AI part cost to run on GoHighLevel?
faq.answer: GoHighLevel's AI Employee add-on is $97 per month per location for unlimited use, or roughly $0.163 per minute pay-per-use. We build and tune the workflow on top of that. The exact fit depends on your lead volume, and we size it with you.

faq.question: How is this built, and is it just a generic template?
faq.answer: It is built specifically for your lead sources and qualification logic inside your own GoHighLevel. We design the conversation logic with Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT Codex, so the agent asks the right questions for your business rather than reading a stock script.

faq.question: What happens if the lead does not answer the first message?
faq.answer: The workflow escalates. SMS opens the conversation, and if there is no reply the AI voice agent calls. Non-responders get tagged into nurture instead of being forgotten, so a slow lead still gets worked without any manual effort.
